package.name: armv7_mode_manager
package.description: Runtime mode coordinator for the armv7 arm: switches between POSITION control (MoveIt / JointTrajectoryController) and FORCE control (Cartesian impedance) without a relaunch. Encapsulates "what a mode means" — which controllers are active and, on real EtherCAT hardware, the CiA-402 drive mode (CSP 8 / CST 10) — behind two Trigger services and a latched current-mode topic, so the rqt panel (or any client) just asks for a mode.
package.author: TianFeiF
